blocks.translation:
△ Caution — To customers who purchased this product: Please read carefully.
● This product is for Ages 15+. Do not give it to children under the recommended age. Be careful to prevent accidental ingestion of button batteries, battery covers, screws, etc. ● This product has pointed or sharp parts; handle and store with care to avoid accidental injury. ● Do not use near the ear. Improper use may impair hearing. ● This product contains electronic parts. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body. ● Do not stare at flashing LED light; it may cause you to feel unwell. ● The included batteries are intended for use with this toy. Do not use them for other purposes, as this may cause an accident. 《Improper use of batteries may cause heat generation, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following》 ● If a button battery is swallowed, or battery fluid leaks into the eye, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water. ● Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Keep out of reach of children. ● Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. ● Insert batteries with the (+) and (−) terminals set correctly. ● Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into a fire. When disposing of batteries, follow local municipal disposal instructions.

blocks.text:
<使用上の注意> ●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で
構成されています。 落としたり、水にぬらしたり、汚したり、分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・低温になるところでの使用、保管は避けてください。
●プラスチック梱包材は、開封後はすぐに捨ててください。 本商品には塗装部分がありますので、 保管の際には他のもの (樹脂製品や家具、
ソファー)と接触しないようにしてください。色が移る場合があります。 ●可動部分・取付部分を無理な方向に強く引っ張ったり、曲げたりしないでくだ
さい。発音の一部にイントネーションが違っていたり、 商品の特性上聞き取りにくいものがありますが、ご了承ください。 ●ガブリカリバー
-MEMORIAL EDITION-には、対応している商品以外はセットしないでください。故障や破損の原因となります。 ●付属の獣電池は、対応している
商品以外にはセットしないでください。故障や破損の原因となります。
blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places of high or low temperature.
• Dispose of plastic packaging materials immediately after opening. This product has painted parts; when storing, avoid contact with other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as color transfer may occur.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable parts or mounting parts in unreasonable directions. Some pronunciations may have different intonation or may be difficult to hear due to the product's characteristics; please understand this.
• Do not set anything other than compatible items into GABURI RIVER -MEMORIAL EDITION-. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
• Do not install the included beast battery in devices other than those it is compatible with. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.

blocks.translation: How to play with the Gaburu Cannon

blocks.text:
①ポンプを1回前後に動かします。
→セリフ「バモラ!」が鳴ります。
②トリガーを短押しします。
強銃撃音が鳴ります。
③ポンプをもう1回前後に動かします。
セリフ「ムーチョ!」が鳴ります。
④トリガーを短押しします。
強銃撃音が鳴ります。
※ポンプを動かすたびに、
セリフ「バモラ!」とセリフ「ムーチョ!」が
交互に鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• 1) Move the pump back and forth one time. → The line "Bamora!" will play.
• 2) Press the trigger briefly. → A strong gunshot sound will play.
• 3) Move the pump back and forth one more time. → The line "Mucho!" will play.
• 4) Press the trigger briefly. → A strong gunshot sound will play.
• ※ Each time you move the pump, the line "Bamora!" and the line "Mucho!" will play alternately.

blocks.translation:

• A separation-release sound will play.
